title: fix(ruby): retry HTTP 423 Locked like the other SDKs

files.patch:
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@ The Svix Server changelog has moved to [server/ChangeLog.md](./server/ChangeLog.
 The Svix Bridge changelog has moved to [bridge/ChangeLog.md](./bridge/ChangeLog.md).
 
 ## Unreleased
+* Libs/Ruby: Retry HTTP 423 Locked responses, like the other SDKs
 * Libs/C#: Improve retry logic (retry on HTTP 423)
 * Libs/Go: Improve retry logic (retry on HTTP 423)
 * Libs/Rust: Improve retry logic (retry on HTTP 423)

@@ -111,7 +111,7 @@ def execute_request(method, path, **kwargs)
       [0.05, 0.1, 0.2].each_with_index do |sleep_duration, index|
         begin
           res = http.request(request)
-          return res unless Integer(res.code) >= 500
+          return res unless Integer(res.code) >= 500 || Integer(res.code) == 423
         rescue *RETRYABLE_ERRORS
           # retried below
         end
